targets.semantic_primary: For the box {0,...,n-1}^d, every subgraph A with |A| < n^d/2 has edge boundary inside the box at least C_d |A|^{(d-1)/d} for a constant C_d depending on d alone.
targets.question_verbatim: Show that there exists a constant $C_d>0$ such that if $A$ is a subgraph of the box $\{0,\dots ,n-1\}^{d}$ and $|A|<n^{d}/2$, then $|\partial_{\E}A|\ge C_d\,|A|^{\frac{d-1}{d}}$. Here, $\partial_{\E}A$ refers to the edge boundary within the box, so this is not a special case of Theorem 6.22.
targets.scope: The single displayed inequality of Exercise 6.74, for the box graph on {0,...,n-1}^d and the edge boundary taken inside that box. The body reference to Theorem 6.22 is a printed disclaimer of special-case status, not a second target, and the exercise number 6.74 appears nowhere else in the 716-page source, so no body theorem carries the same target.
ambient_hypotheses: A is a subgraph of the box {0,...,n-1}^d, i.e. a set of vertices of the box graph; the printed hypothesis is |A| < n^d/2.

functional_definitions.the box: the graph on {0,...,n-1}^d with two vertices adjacent when they differ in exactly one coordinate
functional_definitions.|K|_D, the edge boundary inside D: as defined in the chapter body at physical p. 194 (printed p. 177) and reprinted as uncounted context in the reader
functional_definitions.C_d: a positive constant that may depend on the dimension d; the exercise does not identify it and the reader does not either

targets.author_supply_reused: The complete author Comment on physical p. 637 (printed p. 620): pick m maximising |P_m(A)|, count the full fibres F, bound the boundary by |P_m(A) setminus F|, apply the Loomis-Whitney product via Theorem 6.22 and finish with the explicit constant (1-2^{-1/d}). Reprinted in full in readers/6_74/reader.tex as the primary proof.
targets.method_not_separate_target: The Comment contains one route only; there is no second author solution, so nothing is counted as an alternative target.
targets.excluded_refinement: The choices C_d = 1-2^{-1/d} and the absorption of small n into C_d are recorded by the reviews as mechanical. They are not added to the reader and are not part of the counted target.
